Artifact (Genesis grade), worn in the Hands slot, requires attunement. Needs the stone gate of 1 billion base maximum EP. A carrier: right-click Socket a Stone to set one Infinity Stone from your pack into it (it leaves your pack only once it is set; Space, Mind, Power, Time, Reality, Soul, up to six). Unsocket gives them all back. Every socketed stone answers through the gauntlet with its own acts. Circuit: a stone socketed next to the one before it in the circle (Soul, Mind, Power, Space, Time, Reality, back to Soul) acts 25% stronger and recovers 15% faster. Socketing stings (a share of your health, never lethal), twice as hard as the Infinity Gauntlet. Combos: Mend (Soul, Time, Reality) heals up to 12 allies for 40% and cleanses; Rift (Space, Power) strikes up to 8 foes within 24 blocks. The Snap (all six socketed, hold 5 seconds, 8% existence points, once per 7 game days by default, a server setting): choose Restore, Erase (off unless the server allows it), Purge or Grant. Never touches a player, never an instant kill, at most 40 targets, a boss only loses a tenth. Afterwards a burned arm weakens you for an hour. A stun, bind, paralysis or petrification on the bearer blocks every use.

Stark's nanotech copy of the Infinity Gauntlet: it fits any hand and holds all six stones. Socketing stings twice as hard and a Snap through it leaves a burned arm for an hour. Needs the gate of 1 billion base EP.
item.anime_multiverse.lokis_scepter.card: Weapon (staff, God grade). Needs the stone gate of 1 billion base maximum EP for its stone acts. Holds the Mind Stone only: right-click Socket a Stone with the Mind Stone in your pack. Socketed, it gives the Mind Stone's four acts (Psionic Lance, Psionic Reach, Telekinesis lift and throw, Mind Link) plus Scepter Blast (a bolt of blue light, 16 damage up to 24 blocks) and Scepter Barrier (absorbs 8 damage for 10 seconds). It never takes a will: there is no mind control in this mod. Engraved with magic weapon, severance and magic interference.
item.anime_multiverse.lokis_scepter.desc: A golden spear-staff with a blade, the conduit of the Mind Stone. Socket the Mind Stone to blast, ward and think with it. It never takes a will.
block.anime_multiverse.vormir_altar.desc: A cold orange altar. Right-click to offer your best skill or a named pet for the Soul Stone trial.
